item.title: Build Retro Gaming E-Commerce Store
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | HIRING: Experienced E-Commerce Website Developer
I'm looking to hire an experienced website developer to build a professional online retail business specializing in retro video games, gaming consoles, accessories, and vintage CRT televisions.
My goal is to create an online store similar to DKOldies.com, but with my own branding, design, and additional product categories.
Website Requirements:
- Professional, modern, mobile-friendly e-commerce website - Ability to manage thousands of products as the business grows - Product categories for retro video games, gaming consoles, accessories, and vintage CRT televisions - Product search, filters, photos, descriptions, pricing, and availability - Secure online checkout and payment processing - Nationwide shipping throughout the United States - Automatic shipping calculations based on product weight, dimensions, and destination - Special shipping options for heavy and fragile CRT televisions, including freight shipping and custom shipping quotes - Shipping carrier integration and order tracking - Inventory management and order processing - Customer accounts and order history - Customer reviews, promotional discounts, and special offers - A trade-in section where customers can sell us their used video games, consoles, accessories, and televisions - Easy-to-manage backend for adding products, updating inventory, and managing orders - Search engine optimization (SEO) - Ability to expand and add new features as the business grows
I'm open to Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, or another platform that would best support this type of business.
What I'm Looking For:
I'm looking for someone experienced, reliable, detail-oriented, and capable of building a complete e-commerce website from start to finish.
I'm open to working with developers from anywhere in the world and would prefer someone with experience building online retail stores with large product inventories.
If Interested, Please Send Me:
1. Examples of e-commerce websites you've previously developed. 2. Your experience with Shopify, WooCommerce, or other e-commerce platforms. 3. Your estimated timeline for completing the project. 4. Your pricing or project estimate. 5. Your experience with inventory management, payment processing, and shipping integrations.
I'm serious about building this business and would like to find someone who can help create a professional website that can grow into a major online retailer for retro gaming products.
Please send me a private message with your experience, portfolio, and availability.
Thank you!

item.title: Finish Shopify Website
item.description:
2-8 USD/hr | Shopify Developer Needed ASAP – Complete Existing Website
I'm looking for an experienced and affordable Shopify developer to help finish my existing children's Christian entertainment and merchandise website,
IMPORTANT: This website is already being developed. I have existing Shopify theme code, page designs, mockups, 3D character illustrations, graphics, icons, and branding. I do NOT need someone to build a website from scratch.
Work Required:
1. Complete and polish the homepage and navigation. 2. Finish the family and church membership pages. 3. Create and style the Founders Grove membership presentation and registration pages. 4. Add custom backgrounds, colorful 3D illustrations, buttons, and graphics using my existing assets. 5. Set up merchandise pages for T-shirts, baby onesies, stickers, and future products. 6. Make the website responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop. 7. Fix layout issues and test the website. 8. Prepare membership pages for future subscription and payment integrations.
Budget and Schedule:
- Hourly rate: $5–$6 USD - Up to 8 hours per day - Project duration: 4–5 working days - Maximum initial labor budget: $240 USD - Must be available to start immediately.
Required Skills: Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS3, JavaScript, Shopify Theme Customization, Ecommerce Development, and Responsive Web Design.
Requirements:
- Must have previous Shopify development experience. - Must provide examples of completed Shopify websites. - Must communicate regularly and provide daily progress updates. - Must work on a development theme, not the live website. - Must use my existing designs, code, and graphics. - Must get approval before exceeding the agreed hours. - Must explain what can realistically be completed within 40 hours.
I'm looking for a reliable developer for this project and potentially ongoing work.

item.title: Install Nexoply on VPS Site
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | I need someone comfortable with a quick turnaround to deploy Nexoply onto my existing personal website. The site sits on an Ubuntu-based VPS, and I’ll hand over direct SSH credentials so you can work without delay.
The task is straightforward: clone or upload the Nexoply package, run any required dependency installs, configure environment variables, and confirm that the dashboard and public-facing widgets load correctly on my domain. From past experience it should take no longer than half an hour, so I’m expecting an efficient, clean install rather than an extended build.
Deliverable – Nexoply fully installed, accessible in the browser, and confirmed working with real-time tracking on my live site.
I’ll stay online while you work in case you need quick answers or to test the final setup.

item.title: Shopify Store Setup Screen-Share Coaching
item.description:
25-50 USD/hr | I have already built the public-facing site on GoDaddy and now I’m moving the shopping cart over to Shopify. What I need is a patient Shopify expert who will work with me live, by the hour, through screen-sharing (Zoom, Google Meet, or similar).
First priority: show me how to design the store and link it cleanly to my existing GoDaddy domain so the transition feels seamless to visitors. We will be selling physical items that require shipping, so any theme or settings we touch must keep that in mind.
During the sessions I want to learn, hands-on, how to: • build and fine-tune product pages, create collections, and organise the navigation menu; • adjust colours, fonts or banners only when it helps the product-focused structure; • set up basic shipping rules so I can test a live checkout myself.
I’ll share my screen, you guide me, I do the clicks. After each hour I should be able to repeat the steps on my own. If you’re comfortable coaching in real time and can explain why we’re doing each step—not just what buttons to press—let’s line up our first session this week.
Would prefer applicants in the United States who speak english as a first language, but will consider others

item.title: Rebuild for JSMA.com
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | My current site, www.jsma.com, has out-grown its original WordPress template—the controls are broken and the look feels dated. I want the whole site rebuilt so it feels fresh, contemporary, and responsive on every device while still letting me manage content without technical headaches.
Platform & editing The new build must sit on a website builder that offers free core updates. WordPress remains an option, yet I’m open to builders that are genuinely easier to edit (Webflow, Wix Studio, Squarespace 7.1, etc.). Whatever you recommend, show me how simple it will be for me to tweak copy or swap photos later.
Design direction The primary goal is a more modern look and feel: clean lines, generous white space, intuitive navigation, and strong calls-to-action that guide visitors to enquire. I’m not attached to the current template—replace it entirely. Key pages can stay in place conceptually, but they may need new layouts or reorganised content to match the refreshed design.
International reach Please include an optional Spanish version toggle. If the chosen platform supports native multilingual tools (e.g., Weglot, Polylang, Squarespace Translate), note that in your plan.
Hosting I’m likely to move away from the current host, so advise on a reliable alternative that pairs well with the builder you propose.
Submission notes Show me past work that proves you can: • Transform an outdated site into a modern, mobile-friendly one • Implement user-friendly editors or CMS collections • Add multilingual capability cleanly
PROVIDE AN OUTLINE OF YOUR APPROCH, SUGGESTED WEBSITE BUILDER, AND TIMELINE.

item.title: Braintree Checkout Integration Needed
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I need Braintree’s Drop-in (or a custom-hosted) checkout added to my custom-built website so visitors can make one-time payments. At a minimum the flow must accept credit and debit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Venmo through a single, seamless UI, then return a confirmed transaction ID to my server.
The site already handles shopping-cart logic and order confirmation; what’s missing is the secure payment layer. You’ll be responsible for both the client-side tokenization and the server-side transaction call, using the official Braintree SDKs in whichever language you prefer. Everything has to run in production as well as in the Braintree sandbox for testing.
Deliverables • Fully working checkout embedded in the existing payment page • Server-side code that creates and submits the transaction • Callback/wh webhook handling for success, failure, and duplicate protection • Clear setup notes so I can swap keys and deploy to staging/production
I’ll supply design assets, access to the repo, and Braintree credentials as soon as we start.

item.title: Property Listing & Guest Support
item.description:
10-15 GBP/hr | If you’re already comfortable inside the Airbnb and Vrbo dashboards, use tools like a basic channel manager, and enjoy customer interaction, let’s talk.
’m looking for a proactive coordinator who can take full ownership of my short-term rental portfolio’s online presence while keeping incoming guests happy through quick live-chat responses.
Your first responsibility will be managing the property listings themselves. I’ll rely on you to create new listings from scratch, refresh prices, photos, and amenity details whenever something changes, and then push those updates live on Airbnb and Vrbo. Accuracy here is critical everything guests see must match reality.
Alongside that, you’ll watch the live-chat inbox during agreed-upon hours, answering routine questions, guiding potential guests through the booking process, and escalating anything unusual to me. Friendly, fast replies are a must; the goal is to convert browsers into confirmed bookings and keep current guests reassured.
Key deliverables • New, fully optimised listings for every new property • Ongoing edits—rates, images, descriptions—reflected across Airbnb & Vrbo within 24 hours of notice • Listings published error-free on both platforms and verified live • Real-time chat coverage with an average first-response time under 2 minutes • Weekly summary report covering listing changes, chat volume, common questions, and any issues flagged
If you’re already comfortable inside the Airbnb and Vrbo dashboards, use tools like a basic channel manager, and enjoy customer interaction, let’s talk.

item.title: WordPress Layout Redesign
item.description: 2-8 USD/hr | Our company currently has numerous WordPress websites that require secondary development and modification. Most of these issues are related to the UI, while some require a complete re-development. I am in need of a long-term, full-time partner who can respond promptly. This person must be proficient in WordPress and Shopify development. Since we only have websites on these two platforms, we must be highly skilled in the development of these platforms. The daily work hours are at least 8-10 hours. The tasks are quite simple. My salary is not very high, but it is very stable. I will first present a test contract for work testing. I will first give a few simple tasks for modification, and then proceed with other task development. My weekly compensation is around $120. The price is not very high, but it is very stable. We have a large number of websites, and I need a sincere and cooperative developer with strong capabilities to join us.

item.title: Brilliant Directories Setup & Configuration for a wholesale directory
item.description:
2-8 AUD/hr | The Brilliant Directories framework is already installed on my server; it now needs a full, production-ready configuration so the site functions as a business directory that showcases company listings and collects enquiries through lead forms.
I need someone who works with Brilliant Directories on a regular basis and understands its built-in tools—content widgets, dynamic lead forms, member features, SEO settings, and payment/configuration options—so the job is completed quickly without trial and error. Your task is to:
• Structure categories and sub-levels that make sense for the niche, • Configure the listing pages so each business profile looks professional and pulls in the right data fields, • Set up the lead form workflow (auto-emails, notifications, CRM pipeline inside BD), • Optimise the homepage and search/index pages for speed and on-page SEO, and • Test everything before hand-off, ensuring visitors can browse listings smoothly and send enquiries without glitches.
Please plan the work so it’s handed back as a turn-key directory: all settings documented, demo listings in place to prove functionality, and clear instructions for day-to-day management. If you’ve launched other BD sites, let me know; that experience will be the deciding factor.

item.title: Senior UX/UI Designer to Review and Elevate Two Brand Websites
item.description: 15-25 USD/hr | Category: UX/UI Design. Upwork had auto-tagged it “Logo Design”, so I changed it. Skills: Figma, Web Design, UX Design, UI Design, Visual Communication, Responsive Design, Style Guide. Scope: Medium, 1 to 3 months, Expert level, not contract-to-hire, worldwide talent. Description: It introduces both brands. It says plainly that you don’t want anyone from the betting or gambling space, and that you want fresh eyes and taste in art and design. The work is: audit both sites, propose a design direction with mockups, implement the designs, and get mobile right. The portfolio is the top requirement. Applicants have to name their 2 or 3 best projects and say what they notice first on a new website, which filters out copy-paste proposals.

item.title: Optimize Wix Art Portfolio
item.description:
10-15 GBP/hr | I already host my artwork on a Wix site, but right now it feels more like a storage room than a gallery. I need someone who knows Wix inside-out to turn this into a clean, engaging portfolio that keeps visitors browsing—and ideally clicking on well-placed ads so the site can begin generating revenue.
Here’s what I’m after: • Re-structure the galleries so each section is organised by art style or medium. Only my paintings and drawings will be shown; no other categories are needed. • Improve navigation and page flow so viewers are naturally encouraged to keep moving from piece to piece. • Identify and add tasteful ad spots (Google AdSense or a comparable network) that won’t detract from the artwork but will still earn clicks. • Tidy up image metadata, page titles and on-page SEO so the portfolio stands a better chance of being discovered in search. • Make sure everything looks right on mobile as well as desktop.
I’ll provide full access to the existing Wix project along with all original image files. The finished site should be live on my domain, fully responsive, and ready to start serving ads without compromising the look and feel of the art. If you’ve done similar Wix gallery or portfolio work before, I’d love to see it.

item.title: Publish Case Facts Online
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | My name and professional standing were questioned in a recent dispute, yet every formal finding shows the accusers were untruthful. I now need a concise, fully verifiable account of the case published on a public website or blog so anyone searching the matter can quickly see the documented facts—nothing more, nothing less.
Scope of work • Distill all available records (court rulings, transcripts, exhibits) into a neutral, fact-only narrative that avoids any potentially defamatory wording. • Build a clean, fast-loading web page or small blog—WordPress, static HTML, or another straightforward platform is fine—where that narrative, supporting documents, and source citations can live. Basic SEO (clear URL, title tag, meta description) is expected so the page can be found when my name or the case is Googled. • Provide guidance on future updates should new material surface.
Quality bar • Every sentence must be traceable to a public document I can supply. • Tone stays factual and restrained; no rhetoric or commentary. • Design remains minimal yet professional, readable on mobile and desktop.
When you reply, include a detailed project proposal: outline your workflow for verifying statements, structuring the content, choosing the web platform, and delivering the finished page ready to publish.

item.title: Build Complete eCommerce Store
item.description:
2-8 USD/hr | I want to launch an online store that sells physical products which will be shipped to customers. At first the catalogue will hold no more than 20 items, yet I need every core storefront function in place from day one.
The project covers: • Clean, responsive product pages and a smooth shopping-cart experience. • Secure online payments (Stripe, PayPal, credit-card) with automated order-confirmation emails. • Real-time shipping rates, label generation and customer order-tracking updates.
Please set the store up on the platform you feel is most reliable—Shopify, WooCommerce or another SaaS solution—so long as it allows me to add new products easily, manage inventory, and view sales reports without touching code.
Before hand-off I’ll need a quick walkthrough or short guide that shows how to: – add or edit products, – process and fulfil an order, – issue refunds if necessary.
The store is considered complete once a test order flows from checkout through payment, confirmation email and generated tracking number without errors.

item.title: Clone Peptide Shop Website
item.description:
15-25 AUD/hr | I need an e-commerce site that mirrors every page and feature of https://australianpeptidelabs.com.au/ while swapping the blue palette for a fresh green and re-branding all instances to “Australian Peptide Co.” From the public storefront through to the customer account area, blog, shipping calculator and discount code functions, everything visible (and under the hood) on the reference site should be replicated.
I’ll supply the full catalogue—product names, descriptions, images and pricing—so you can focus on design, build and configuration. Customers must be able to complete their purchase with standard credit or debit cards, so please connect a reliable card gateway (Stripe or a comparable option you recommend).
Deliverables • Pixel-level match to the reference layout, typography and user flow, recoloured in green and updated branding • Responsive design that performs smoothly on desktop, tablet and mobile • Secure card-payment checkout fully tested end-to-end • All pages, menus and functional elements from the source site recreated and online with my provided content loaded • Final deployment on my hosting plus a short admin walk-through so I can manage products and orders myself
If you normally work in WordPress + WooCommerce, Shopify, or another modern e-commerce stack, let me know which you prefer and why; I’m open as long as it delivers the identical experience and easy self-management afterward.

item.title: Full-Service Amazon Store Management
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | We're launching an Amazon store and need a comprehensive, end-to-end management service. We need you to build out the store design per our concepts. And then expert marketing to drive visibility and sales. Mainly clothing, accessories, home & living items.
Requirements: - Store setup and product listing: We need an appealing and optimized store, with all products listed professionally from the get-go. - Product sourcing: We expect high-quality, trendy clothing that's competitively priced. - Inventory management: Efficient tracking and management of stock levels. - Customer service and returns: Excellent customer service to handle inquiries and returns promptly and professionally.
Ideal Skills: - Proven experience in e-commerce, particularly on Amazon - Strong background in marketing and promotions - Excellent inventory management skills - Customer service expertise - Proven positive track record with end to end Amazon store management. - Experience with Printful to Amazon integrations (Not required but useful)
We will be using Printful as our print-on-demand and dropshipping service. It integrates with Amazon. Please familiarize yourself with that platform.
